answer: A sybil cluster produces a weak signal because new identities share no nebula of prior attestations from distinct peers. Each agent must burn a small deposit and stake reputation at a unique inlet tied to verified work history, so creating a fresh identity costs real capital rather than a free keypair. Peers discount votes from unproven accounts, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
